omissionRisks.risk: Treating the title's GPT-4 question as a proven head-to-head result.
omissionRisks.why: Visible numeric comparison is Qwen2 versus Llama 3/other open models; the full timeline shows no matched GPT-4 output.
omissionRisks.requiredFollowup: Capture all comparison tables and prompt/output screens; explicitly record the absent GPT-4 baseline over the full timeline.

omissionRisks.risk: Collapsing the five-size Qwen2 family listing, four-column specification card, 72B/7B tables, base/Instruct variants, and demo checkpoints into one identity.
omissionRisks.why: The visible family page includes 57B-A14B, the later specification card does not, and separate benchmark tables use different model scales/competitors.
omissionRisks.requiredFollowup: Capture the five-size listing and four-column card separately; keep 72B and 7B benchmark identities separate; preserve unknown demo identity when unreadable.

omissionRisks.risk: Upgrading selected benchmark screenshots into universal capability superiority or missing direct counterexamples inside the same table.
omissionRisks.why: The 72B table gives Llama3-70B-Instruct higher MBPP and GSM8K values, while methodology and multimodal proof remain absent; cross-row OCR can also misassign 82.3 from MBPP to HumanEval.
omissionRisks.requiredFollowup: Capture exact table identities/rows, record MBPP 80.2/82.3 and GSM8K 91.1/93.0 as direct counterexamples, and preserve the small-table HumanEval row as 79.9/62.2/71.8.

omissionRisks.risk: Calling edited UI a live, successful, reproducible test.
omissionRisks.why: The video shows prompt/output states but not complete uninterrupted execution, parameters, hardware, latency, or code execution.
omissionRisks.requiredFollowup: Capture before/during/after frames and list every missing execution dependency.

omissionRisks.risk: Inventing the source, wording, authority, or adoption scale of brief social/developer screenshots.
omissionRisks.why: Some text and identities are small and montage-based.
omissionRisks.requiredFollowup: OCR visible names/lines; mark the rest partial or unknown.

omissionRisks.risk: Silently correcting ASR conflicts and losing the exact burned-caption meaning.
omissionRisks.why: The supplied SRT has many errors ('黃仁熊', 'La Ma 3', '黏壓', etc.), while the visible captions support different wording.
omissionRisks.requiredFollowup: Preserve verbatim SRT, record high-impact conflicts atomically, and use checked visual wording only in interpretation.
